name: "TruffleHog Secret Scan"

on:
  push:
    branches: ["main", "master"]
  pull_request:
    branches: ["main", "master"]
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 0 * * 0"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  actions: read
  contents: read
  security-events: write
  id-token: write
  issues: write

jobs:
  ScanSecrets:
    name: Scan for secrets and credentials
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10  # Safety limit
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: TruffleHog OSS
        id: trufflehog
        uses: trufflesecurity/trufflehog@v3.88.2  # Pinned version
        continue-on-error: true
        with:
          path: ./
          base: "${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}"
          extra_args: --filter-entropy=4 --results=verified,unknown --only-verified

      - name: Scan Results Status
        if: steps.trufflehog.outcome == 'failure'
        run: exit 1
